634.name: Essence Wok of Gurtug's Will
634.desc: 41 random stat points. This wok bore Gurtug's fiercest fire, and his deepest regret.

635.name: Essence Bottle of Gurtug's Will
635.desc: 41 random stat points. Gurtug boiled a lifetime of craft down to a few drops of essence and sealed them in this bottle for whoever reaches the seventh floor.

636.name: Essence Crown of Gurtug's Will
636.desc: 41 random stat points. The enshrined crown goes only to the longest-serving guardian of the tower. Gurtug wore it, yet always gazed beyond the tower.

637.name: Searing Spatula of Yinchen's Fall
637.desc: 25 random stat points. Yinchen was once Duma's proudest pupil, but she found her master's fire too quiet and insisted on burning the stove hotter.

638.name: Searing Blade of Yinchen's Fall
638.desc: 25 random stat points. The day she left the sixth floor, Yinchen took only this knife; its edge still bears scorch marks.

639.name: Searing Wok of Yinchen's Fall
639.desc: 25 random stat points. This wok always glows red-hot. Yinchen says only searing heat can draw out every flavor of an ingredient.

640.name: Searing Bottle of Yinchen's Fall
640.desc: 25 random stat points. Inside is a sauce Yinchen blended in the tower's shadows, so fragrant you forget the way back.

641.name: Jade•Sponsor Hat
641.desc: A thank-you to restaurants that have contributed to the town. Creativity +25.

642.name: Xuan•Sponsor Hat
642.desc: A thank-you to restaurants that have contributed to the town, obtained at 6 stars. Creativity +41.

90001.name: New Year Bell

90002.name: Fortune Paper-cut

90003.name: Revolving Lantern
90003.desc: Little figures holding sweet rice balls spin endlessly inside the lantern; one turn is a whole year of fun in town. (Lantern Festival souvenir)

90004.name: Chocolate Gift Box
90004.desc: Handmade chocolates tied with a ribbon; they say the dessert shop next door sent them secretly. (Valentine's Day souvenir)

90005.name: Zongzi Sachet

90006.name: Sugar-painting Pinwheel
90006.desc: A little pinwheel drawn in malt sugar; too pretty to eat, so it sits on the counter. (Children's Day souvenir)

90007.name: Magpie Bridge Sachet
90007.desc: A sachet embroidered with magpies; on Qixi the couples' tables always fill up first. (Qixi Festival souvenir)

90008.name: Jade Rabbit Lantern
90008.desc: A rabbit lantern of white paper whose light falls just on the mooncakes on the table. (Mid-Autumn souvenir)

90009.name: Little Red Flag Pin
90009.desc: A little red flag pinned to your apron; every table takes a second look during the long holiday. (National Day souvenir)

90010.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
90010.desc: A pumpkin carved with a smiling face; the scooped-out flesh became pumpkin soup the next day. (Halloween souvenir)

90011.name: Gingerbread House
90011.desc: A gingerbread cottage with a sugar-dusted roof that looks cozier than the real restaurant. (Christmas souvenir)

90012.name: Golden Soup Ladle

90101.name: Ichiban Kuji Prize A Figure

90104.name: Ichiban Kuji Last Prize Figure

91101.desc: A chef sitting on a pumpkin bigger than himself, ladle in hand. (Ichiban Kuji · Harvest Feast)

91102.name: Candied Chestnut Master Figure
91102.desc: A master stir-frying chestnuts in a big iron wok; the smell reaches half the street. (Ichiban Kuji · Harvest Feast)

91103.name: Rice Ear Charm
91103.desc: A small bunch of golden rice ears tied with red string. (Ichiban Kuji · Harvest Feast)

91104.name: Harvest Barn Feast Ornament

91112.desc: A vendor pushing a roaster, handing out a sweet potato oozing with syrup. (Ichiban Kuji · Hearthside Stews)

91114.name: Fireside Chat Ornament
